candidates.description: This feature vector represents indefinite pronouns and interrogative words related to unspecified objects, people, or concepts.
This vector represents abstract mental constructs, ideas, and foundational principles or methods.
These tokens represent conjunctive adverbs and transitional words used to indicate logical relationships, contrasts, or consequences between clauses.
This vector represents common present and past tense action verbs describing physical or abstract transfers and creations.
This vector represents the concept of being, reality, or existing.
This vector represents internal mental states, emotions, and cognitive attitudes such as belief, hope, fear, and desire.
This vector represents abstract intellectual, literary, and philosophical concepts.
This feature vector activates on adjectives and nouns expressing conditions of possibility, necessity, or capability.
This feature vector activates on names of prominent philosophers, thinkers, and historical cultural figures.
This vector activates on em dashes and en dashes used as punctuation marks or clitics in text.
